name: etlsql-browser-lint
description: Pinned toolchain for the browser-side lint gate (eslint.config.mjs at the repository root). A sibling of scripts/typecheck for the same reason that one exists: keeping it out of the root means the repository has no root package.json, so node does not treat every .js file in the tree as belonging to a package with no "type" and warn on each one it has to detect as ESM.
